title: StateImportHoldings

profiles.description: The provider logins it lists, one per config directory, of every provider. Zero when its file is absent; null when its file is there but could not be read.

banks.description: The memory banks its registry lists. Zero when its file is absent; null when its file is there but could not be read.

routines.description: The routines it lists, both those of the source's desktop and those of its headless service. Zero when its file is absent; null when its file is there but could not be read.

instructions.description: The custom instructions it lists, and the built-in ones whose text was taken over. Zero when its file is absent; null when its file is there but could not be read.

skillSources.description: The tracked skill repositories it lists. Zero when its file is absent; null when its file is there but could not be read.

connections.description: The key-manager connections it lists. Zero when its file is absent; null when its file is there but could not be read.

description: What a source data folder holds, by kind: profiles, banks, routines, instructions, skill sources and key-manager connections.
